data_generating_process: US Equities intraday order book and tick microstructure data aggregated to daily metrics, capturing full-book queue sizes, trade sizes, smart flow, bid/ask distances, and intraday price volatility.

mean_trade_size_1min.description: Average trade size per 1-minute interval during the day; strong institutional block trade and accumulation footprint.

mean_high_trade_size_1min.description: Average of the highest trade size in each 1-minute interval, isolating institutional execution spikes.

mean_daily_smflow_topbook.description: Daily mean of cumulative smart order flow over top of book; directional aggressive buyer/seller order flow imbalance.

mean_interval_smflow_top.description: Average interval smart flow value at top of order book during the day.

mean_cumulative_smflow_1min.description: Average cumulative smflow per 1-minute interval throughout the trading day.

mean_ask_distance_from_mid_fullbook.description: Average distance of ask orders from mid price in full book; reflects depth cushion and selling resistance.

mean_bid_distance_from_mid_fullbook.description: Average distance of bid orders from mid price in full book; reflects buying support queue elasticity.

mean_volume_above_mid_top.description: Average traded volume executed above the mid quote at top of book; buyer-initiated aggression.

sum_volume_above_mid_intraday.description: Total intraday volume executed above mid quote; aggregate aggressive buying pressure.

mean_log_bid_ask_size_ratio_top.description: Average log ratio of bid size to ask size at top of order book; inverted for queue imbalance pressure.

mean_weighted_bid_size_fullbook.description: Weighted bid size in full order book emphasizing deeper levels; deep institutional limit order support.

mean_weighted_ask_size_fullbook.description: Weighted ask size in full order book emphasizing deeper levels; deep institutional limit order resistance.

sum_trade_count_intraday.description: Total number of trades executed throughout the day; retail vs institutional transaction density trigger.

mean_daily_trade_count_topbook.description: Daily average number of trades executed at the top of the order book.

mean_intraday_price_volatility_top.description: Average intraday volatility of trade prices at top of order book; natural uncertainty and execution noise divisor.
